description: This file defines data models, interfaces, and a data source class for managing widget actions within the Thingsboard UI. It includes classes for handling widget action descriptors, sources, and a data source implementation for reactive data management.

classes.name: WidgetActionsDatasource
classes.description: A reactive data source class for managing and fetching widget action descriptors, supporting pagination, filtering, and translation.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the data source to a collection viewer, returning an observable of widget actions.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the data source, completing internal subjects.

methods.name: setActions
methods.description: Sets the actions map and sources for the data source.

methods.name: loadActions
methods.description: Loads widget actions with optional reloading, returning page data as an observable.

methods.name: fetchActions
methods.description: Fetches a page of widget actions based on a page link.

methods.name: getAllActions
methods.description: Retrieves all widget actions, caching the result.

methods.name: toWidgetActionDescriptorInfo
methods.description: Converts a WidgetActionDescriptor to a detailed WidgetActionDescriptorInfo with source info and translations.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the actions subject is empty.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns total number of widget actions.
